==Description==
The '''Lead Detection Buff''' is a buff that grants all the towers affected by it lead detection, meaning they can now damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies. It is only displayed in the tower upgrade menu.

==Mechanics==
[[Units]], the [[Railgun Tank]], [[Body Guards 2]] or [[War Machine Sentry]] are not affected by the '''Lead Detection Buff''', even if the unit or the tower that spawned it are in the range of the tower that applied the '''Lead Detection Buff''' to them.

==Applied By==
The following towers can apply the '''Lead Detection Buff''' to other towers:
*[[Firework Technician]] (Passive at the start of the wave)
The following event features can apply the '''Lead Detection Buff''' to towers:

* [[The Sun]] (Passive at the start of the wave, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
